final_notes: SETTLED: 1) Score is per block, divided by the taller tower. One word per block, so message length equals target height, max 8. Blocks are built in word order. Targets taller than 8 cap at 8/height; cover the first 8 blocks. ; 2) Colour words: tumu purple, zeki blue, kano blue, neto yellow, fuza green, loku red, melu orange, vonu red (star). ; 3) loku, melu and vonu build stars. All other colour words build rings. Green, yellow, blue and purple stars cannot be built, so those blocks get only 0.25 for the colour match. ; 4) Fillers continue the previous colour as a RING. Confirmed: tido and fidi after zeki, mape and dobo after orange, vepu after neto (yellow ring). Fillers are wrong if the colour changes. Repeating a colour word is safe. For orange or red, use the star word once, then fillers. ; 5) Only rings and stars have ever been built. Cone, cube and ball targets cap at 0.25 per block, so only colour can be matched there. ; 6) kuru is a coin flip between red and orange rings. Do not use it. ; 7) One colour word per block is safe. Sender and builder mappings agree. ; OPEN: Whether any word gives a cone, cube or ball. Nothing tried so far has. ; nove and muva are untested individually and are probably fillers. ; Whether a filler works in first position. ; Whether red rings work as loku plus a filler. ; Whether a shape word exists at all. Probably not. ; TRY NEXT: As sender, use one colour word per block, length equal to target height (max 8). Never put a filler across a colour change. ; For ring targets, use a colour word then fillers only if the colour stays the same. Use star words for star targets. ; On a non-ring target, test nove or muva on one block to look for a new shape, keeping the rest safe. ; As builder, build in word order and note my choices for unclear words.

SETTLED: Score per block is 1 if colour and shape both match, 0.25 if only one matches. The sum is divided by the taller tower's height.
SETTLED: One block per word, read left to right, bottom to top, max 8 words. Targets over 8 blocks cap the score (last round 9 blocks, 0.64).
SETTLED: Colour words: fuza = green, zeki = blue, kano = blue, neto = yellow, tumu = purple, melu = orange, loku = red, vonu = red.
SETTLED: fuza, neto, zeki, kano and tumu build rings. melu builds an orange star. loku and vonu build red stars.
SETTLED: Fillers mape, dobo, tido, fidi and now vepu build a ring in the previous colour (neto vepu neto gave 3 yellow rings). They carry no shape meaning.
SETTLED: Only rings, red stars and orange stars score fully. Any other shape scores 0.25 per block through colour alone.
SETTLED: Leading kuru is undecodable and scored 0.
